summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine director/PDMR shareholdings. The filing discloses that on May 19, 2026, the CFO and CEO each acquired ordinary shares and ADSs through dividend reinvestment at £3.4022 per share and $9.2446 per ADS, respectively, on the London and New York stock exchanges. These are standard insider transactions following a dividend payment, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other corporate-event content. It is a routine disclosure of PDMR dealings under UK Market Abuse Regulation, mapped to the equivalent US Form 4/5 requirement for reporting insider transactions.
